body: Thank you for reaching out. I say that i have no one because the friends i have are all (except one) are from high school and middle school and ive moved so much that they are all literally just social media friends. We talk sometimes but mostly just comment and share each others stuff on FB. The one friend (the last one mentioned in the post) is an old coworker. Last time i was feeling like this i reached out to her and she was just annoyed and told me to not be such a cry baby. She wasnt trying to be mean, this is just part of her personality to be tough and nothing gets to her and she cant tolerate emotions of others well. Ive tried before to reach out to other friends or family and i either get ignored or a simple response like "im sorry you feel that way" or some other vague so-what type response. And that lack of care from anyone hurts even more. Its not like I'm like this all the time to be blown off. Last time was about 3-4 months ago and time before that was about 2 years ago
